scripts.format: npm run format:api && npm run format:web
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:web
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:desktop && npm run test && npm run check:artifacts
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web && npm run test:scripts
scripts.test:web: npm --prefix apps/web run test:unit && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.test:e2e:real-browser:large: FRAMEPILOT_IMPORT_TIMING=1 FRAMEPILOT_BROWSER_PERF_COUNT=500 FRAMEPILOT_BROWSER_PERF_WIDTH=3000 FRAMEPILOT_BROWSER_PERF_HEIGHT=2000 FRAMEPILOT_BROWSER_PERF_QUALITY=88 npm run test:e2e:real-browser
scripts.test:e2e:real-browser:large:trace: FRAMEPILOT_IMPORT_TIMING=1 FRAMEPILOT_BROWSER_PERF_TRACE=1 FRAMEPILOT_BROWSER_PERF_COUNT=500 FRAMEPILOT_BROWSER_PERF_WIDTH=3000 FRAMEPILOT_BROWSER_PERF_HEIGHT=2000 FRAMEPILOT_BROWSER_PERF_QUALITY=88 npm run test:e2e:real-browser
scripts.check:pretag: npm run verify && npm run check:validation-decision
